name: heap-code
description: Model-agnostic AI coding assistant. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API — Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, vLLM, and more.

heapcode.profiles.markdownDescription: Named provider profiles. Each item: `{ name, preset, baseUrl, model, temperature?, maxTokens?, headers?, capabilities? }`. Each role (edit/apply/completion/agent/embeddings/rerank) can also be pointed at a *different* profile entirely via its `<role>Profile` field (e.g. `embeddingsProfile: "my-ollama-profile"`) — lets you mix providers per role, e.g. embeddings on local Ollama while chat/agent use a cloud profile. API keys are NOT stored here — use the *Heap Code: Set API Key* command (OS keychain). Presets: `openai`, `ollama`, `ollama-cloud`, `azure-openai`, `openrouter`, `together`, `groq`, `nvidia-nim`, `lmstudio`, `vllm`, `localai`, `custom`.

editProfile.description: Run the edit role on a different configured profile entirely (its baseUrl/key/model) instead of this one. Name of another profile; unset = use this profile.

applyProfile.description: Run the apply role on a different configured profile entirely, instead of this one.

completionProfile.description: Run the autocomplete role on a different configured profile entirely, instead of this one.

agentProfile.description: Run agent mode on a different configured profile entirely, instead of this one.

embeddingsProfile.description: Run embeddings (semantic search / RAG) on a different configured profile entirely — e.g. a local Ollama profile while chat/agent stay on a cloud profile.

rerankProfile.description: Run the semantic-search rerank step on a different configured profile entirely, instead of this one.

contextProfile.description: Run the contextual-retrieval blurb generation step (indexing) on a different configured profile entirely, instead of this one.

contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens (prompt + output). Drives the context usage meter and automatic conversation compaction. Default 32768.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in ms: full response for non-streaming calls, time-to-first-token for streaming/agent calls (not the whole reply). Default 300000. Raise this for local/slow models on large prompts (e.g. agent tasks).

heapcode.activeProfile.description: Name of the active provider profile. Switch via the status bar.

heapcode.customPrompts.markdownDescription: User prompt library. Each item: `{ command, title, template }` — usable as `/command` in chat. Templates support `{input}` (text after the command) and `{selection}` (current editor selection).

heapcode.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Legacy fallback endpoint, used only when `heapcode.profiles` is empty. Prefer profiles.

heapcode.model.markdownDescription: Legacy fallback model, used only when `heapcode.profiles` is empty. Prefer profiles.

heapcode.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate per response.

heapcode.completion.delay.description: Debounce in ms before requesting a completion.

heapcode.completion.maxTokens.description: Max tokens to generate per completion.

heapcode.completion.triggerMode.markdownDescription: `auto`: suggest while typing. `manual`: only on Alt+\ (Heap Code: Trigger Completion).

heapcode.completion.repoContext.markdownDescription: Include a couple of similar snippets from elsewhere in the repo (via the semantic-search index) in completion prompts. Typing-triggered completions use a fast keyword-only lookup (no extra model call); manual-trigger completions (Alt+\) also use the full semantic index. No-op until the workspace index has chunks.

heapcode.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers exposed to the agent. Keyed by name. stdio: `{ "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path"] }` — remote: `{ "url": "https://…", "transport": "http" }` (or `sse`). MCP tools go through the same permission prompts as other agent actions.

heapcode.rag.autoIndex.markdownDescription: Index the workspace in the background for semantic search. No-op until the active profile has an `embeddingsModel` (e.g. `nomic-embed-text` on Ollama). Respects `.heapcodeignore`.

heapcode.repoMap.enable.markdownDescription: Build and maintain a persisted symbol outline of the workspace in the background (file paths + top-level function/class names, no code) for the agent's `repo_map` tool. No model required — pure parsing. Respects `.heapcodeignore`.

heapcode.rag.rerank.markdownDescription: Rerank semantic-search hits with the LLM (edit model, else chat model) before using them. Better precision at the cost of one extra small model call per search. Falls back to plain vector order on any failure.

heapcode.rag.hybridSearch.markdownDescription: Fuse embedding search with BM25 keyword search (reciprocal rank fusion) before reranking. Catches exact-identifier queries pure embedding search misses. Free — no extra model calls.

heapcode.rag.contextualRetrieval.markdownDescription: Generate a short LLM blurb per chunk at index time describing what it is and where it fits, embedded alongside the chunk for better retrieval ("contextual retrieval"). Off by default: unlike rerank, this runs once per **changed chunk**, not once per query, so it adds real time to indexing. Uses the Context model role (status bar → Select model → Context) — a small fast model like `qwen2.5-coder:3b` on Ollama works well.

heapcode.agent.planFirst.description: Agent writes a numbered plan first, then executes it step by step.

heapcode.agent.planGate.markdownDescription: Stop after the plan (`#heapcode.agent.planFirst#`) and wait for you to click "Approve & Run" before any files are touched, instead of auto-continuing into execution.

heapcode.agent.maxIterations.description: Maximum plan→act→observe iterations per agent session. A session that reaches it is cut off mid-task with a progress summary, so this only wants lowering to keep a model on a short leash.

heapcode.agent.disabledTools.description: Agent tools switched off in the chat's tools picker (🔧). Disabled tools are not offered to the model.

heapcode.agent.safeMode.description: Ask for permission on every non-read action, ignoring session/always grants.

heapcode.agent.commandTimeout.description: Terminal command timeout in seconds for agent-run commands.

heapcode.agent.askUserQuestionTimeout.markdownDescription: How long an agent question waits with no activity before the agent is told you may be away and carries on with its own judgment — e.g. `60s`, `5m`, `10m`. Empty (the default) waits indefinitely. Typing or refocusing the question resets the clock, and the last 20 seconds are shown as a countdown. A question the agent marked as gating an action ("may I delete this?") never times out regardless of this setting.

heapcode.agent.memoryDistillation.markdownDescription: At the end of a successful agent session, ask whether anything's worth remembering long-term (a convention, constraint, or gotcha discovered) and — with your confirmation — append it to `.heapcode/memory.md`. Never writes without asking first.

heapcode.agent.requireTestsBeforeFinish.markdownDescription: Block the agent's `finish` (once, with a nudge) if it changed files since the last passing `run_tests` call. Off by default — turn on for projects with a fast, reliable test command.

heapcode.agent.subAgents.markdownDescription: Offer the agent a `delegate_task` tool to hand off a self-contained piece of work to an isolated sub-agent (its own fresh context, optionally a different persona/model profile), one at a time. Off by default — this is a new, autonomy-increasing capability, same posture as `#heapcode.agent.planGate#` and `#heapcode.agent.requireTestsBeforeFinish#`.

heapcode.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Send anonymous usage telemetry (which commands/features are used, coarse error counts) to help prioritize development. Never includes code, prompts, file contents, or file paths. Also honors VS Code's own `#telemetry.telemetryLevel#` — set that to `off` and Heap Code sends nothing regardless of this setting. See the README "Telemetry" section for exactly what's collected.

heapcode.completion.template.markdownDescription: FIM prompt format. `auto` detects from the model id; `chat` forces the chat-based fallback for models without FIM support.

heapcode.webSearch.provider.markdownDescription:
Search backend for the agent's `web_search` tool. **Off by default** — while off the tool stays visible to the model but every call is refused, so it cannot silently reach the internet.

- `duckduckgo` — no API key or signup. DuckDuckGo publishes no search API, so this parses its HTML results page: it works, but it is unofficial, rate-limits quickly (requests are spaced ~2s apart and 429s are retried with backoff), and can break if their markup changes.
- `brave` / `tavily` / `serper` — hosted APIs, far more reliable; run **Heap Code: Set Web Search API Key** to store the key in the OS keychain (never in settings.json). Brave's free tier allows ~1 request/second, which is enforced here.
- `searxng` — your own SearXNG instance; no key and no third party. Set `#heapcode.webSearch.baseUrl#` if it isn't on `http://localhost:8888/search`.
- `custom` — any endpoint returning Brave/Tavily/Serper/SearXNG-shaped JSON.

Results are treated as untrusted content, the same as `fetch_url` and MCP output.

heapcode.webSearch.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Overrides the search endpoint for the selected provider. Needed for a self-hosted SearXNG on a non-default address, and for `custom`.

heapcode.webSearch.maxResults.markdownDescription: How many results `web_search` returns to the model. Snippets are capped per result, so this is the main lever on how much context one search spends.

heapcode.webSearch.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-attempt timeout for a search request. Retries (up to 3, with backoff on 429/5xx) each get a fresh timeout.
